mechanism: Benztropine's anticholinergic effects may reduce gastrointestinal motility and delay primaquine absorption, while both drugs can cause CNS effects and benztropine may mask neurological symptoms of primaquine toxicity.
action: Monitor for delayed primaquine efficacy and CNS adverse effects; consider spacing doses and assessing for primaquine-related hemolytic anemia or neuropathy despite anticholinergic masking.
